who.value: Pro seller hosting a live auction from the desktop console

job.value: spin a giveaway whose winner must answer a question (HK/MY), and run polls for viewers

arrivedFrom.value: the seller's Live dashboard during the show

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: It reads as the live console (Lots, Shop items, the stream, Live stats); the giveaway question rule only shows once the 'Giveaway 128 entries' pill is opened.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The 'Giveaway' pill on the video and the 'Poll' text button under it are small next to the green + button and the Lots list, so neither control stands out.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Poll' predicts creating a poll, but the 'Giveaway 128 entries' pill doesn't say that tapping it is how you spin.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Antisniping', 'Auction tiers' and 'Giveaway' are the console's existing terms a hosting seller already knows.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Creating a poll asks for a question, answers and who sees results, all things the host decides on the spot.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: The poll composer and the Spin dialog with the question rule open only when asked for.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything belongs to hosting the show: lots sold, shop items, the stream and chat.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Labels and values carry the console; no paragraph to read before acting.
